source.title: Chrome Music Lab — Kandinsky
source.creator: Google Creative Lab / Chrome Music Lab

rationale: Maps freehand visual marks directly to sound, making drawing simultaneously a compositional input and an audiovisual score.
notes: The Chrome Music Lab project describes hands-on browser experiments and states that experiments use open web technologies including Web Audio API, WebMIDI and Tone.js. Kandinsky specifically centers drawing as the sound-making gesture.

decision.rationale: Adds a canonical cross-modal direct-manipulation example where the same user gesture generates both visible form and sound rather than controlling two separate interfaces.
